subject: computer-science
title: Programming Basics: Loops
welcome_lead: Loops let your code repeat work without you copying lines.
meta_desc: KS3 programming: for loops, while loops, counters and ranges.
final_note: Loops turn long, repetitive code into short, reliable programs.

concepts.def: Repeats a fixed number of times.
Repeats while a condition stays true.
A sequence of numbers a for loop walks through.
A variable that counts loop iterations.
A loop whose condition never becomes false.
Command that exits a loop immediately.

walkthroughs.body_html: for i in range(5): runs the body five times with i = 0,1,2,3,4. Use a for loop when you know how many repeats you need.
while score < 10: repeats while the condition is true. Useful when the number of repeats depends on user input.
If a while condition never becomes false, the program freezes. Make sure something inside the loop changes the condition.
